gloss: gut; gut string (for racket or instrument)

definitions.gloss: gut; gut string (for racket or instrument)
definitions.explanation: String made from animal intestines (or synthetic equivalent), used to string tennis rackets, badminton rackets, and stringed musical instruments.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラケット→ラケット：00351_raketto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ガット⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: The strings on my racket broke.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧ガット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}って→張る：12583_haru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had new strings put on (the racket).

examples.japanese: ⟦テニス→テニス：01784_tenisu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ガット⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{硬|かた}さ⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{打|う}ち{心地|ごこち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The feel of tennis strings changes depending on their tension.

notes:
From English 'gut'. Originally referred to strings made from animal intestines; today most strings are nylon or synthetic, but the term ガット is still used for racket strings in general.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ガット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to string (a racket)
- ガット⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: (strings) to break
- ガット⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{張|は}り{替|か}え: restringing
- ⟦ナチュラル→ナチュラル：29886_nachuraru⟧ガット: natural gut (true animal-gut string)

NOTE: Not to be confused with the homophone GATT (⟦{関税|かんぜい}→関税：05136_kanzei⟧⟦{及|およ}び→及び：06922_oyobi⟧⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かん}する→関する：02045_kansuru⟧{一般協定|いっぱんきょうてい}, the pre-WTO trade agreement), which is written the same way in katakana.
